newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dunloe acquires Irish property portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Dunloe acquires Irish property portfolio.

text.p: Dunloe House Group Plc said on Thursday it had reached agreement, subject to shareholder approval and due diligence, to acquire a large property portfolio in Ireland.
The properties involved are owned by the Monarch Properties Limited Group and the Aviette Limited Group, Dunloe said in a statement.

"The size of the proposed transaction, which in terms of both the investment and development properties is larger than Dunloe's existing portfolio, makes it a reverse takeover under stock exchange rules and accordingly the board of Dunloe House had requested a suspension of its shares from 0830 today," the company said.
Dunloe also announced that it made a pre-tax profit of 206,967 Irish pounds in the year ended December 31, 1996 compared with a loss of 36,600 punts in 1995.
